sidebar-connections-hint: Manage the connections that power Reina.
models-page-description: Configure a provider. Select a model for Reina.
javascript-required: Enable JavaScript to manage Reina settings.
runtime-apply-warning: Applying configuration can start bounded issue scans and use the selected model. Coding still requires explicit approval.
provider-empty-description: Connect an account or API key, save a model, then select it for Reina.
model-selection-hint: Saving a model does not select it. Choose Select model to save your preference. Runtime status shows whether the configuration is applied.
models-empty-description: No saved models yet. Configure a provider, then save a model from its catalog or enter your own.
runtime-settings-description: Configure one repository and its worker policy. Refresh status keeps your unsaved edits.
github-connect-repository-hint: Connect GitHub to select a verified repository.
github-identity-manual-hint: Manual identity fields are retained for compatibility. A connected repository supplies these values automatically.
webhook-secret-first-save-hint: Write-only. Enter at least 32 characters for the first save. Use the same secret in your GitHub App webhook configuration. Saved secrets are never displayed.
worker-image-hint: Use a prepared worker image ID, sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, or an image reference pinned with @sha256: and that digest. Tags alone are not allowed.
allowed-paths-hint: One repository-relative pattern per line, up to 64 patterns of 256 characters each. Blank lines are ignored. Forbidden paths take priority.
forbidden-paths-hint: Name this repository's security and deployment domains. For example, src/auth/**, infra/**, or .github/** may need protection in your repository. These examples are not a complete policy. Enter your own list: one repository-relative pattern per line, up to 64 patterns of 256 characters each.
verification-commands-hint: Enter a JSON array of argument arrays, for example [["npm","run","ci"]]. Use 1–8 commands with 1–32 non-empty string arguments each. Commands run directly, not through a shell. Do not enter a shell command string.
runtime-concurrency-hint: Maximum concurrent jobs is fixed at 1. Reina runs one job at a time to keep work bounded.
runtime-save-warning: Saving also applies these settings with a safe runtime reload. Issue scans and model use can start; coding still requires explicit approval.
github-connect-description: Authorize your GitHub account, then choose a repository available to this service's GitHub App. Existing App installations can be reused.
github-connect-warning: Continue to the official GitHub authorization page in this tab. Repository selection can resume a matching saved Runtime configuration. Coding still requires explicit approval.
github-setup-required-notice: This service needs one-time GitHub App setup. Choose Connect GitHub to open the missing settings. Existing App keys and matching webhook settings are retained.
github-repository-picker-hint: Only verified repositories available to your account and this App are listed. Selection is not saved until you choose Use repository.
github-repository-selection-warning: Repository selection can resume a complete saved Runtime configuration. The App, repository, and installation must match. Scans use its saved worker image and policy and can use model quota. Unsaved form edits do not stop this restart. Save and apply is required to change worker settings or policy. Repository selection does not approve coding.
github-install-help: To add repositories, use Install / manage App on GitHub. If organization approval is required, ask an organization owner to approve the request, then refresh repositories to check access again. If this connection attempt has expired, use Connect GitHub again. Reina cannot approve requests for you.
github-service-setup-title: Service operator: one-time GitHub App setup
github-service-setup-description: This section is for the service operator, not users connecting a repository. Register an existing GitHub App for this Reina service. Credentials are write-only and are never displayed.
github-setup-urls-instruction: In your GitHub App settings, register the exact callback URL and setup URL below. Enable Redirect on update.
github-setup-oauth-instruction: Leave Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation off. Connect GitHub starts a separate authorization flow with PKCE.
github-setup-credentials-instruction: Enter the App ID and client secret. Configure the same webhook secret in GitHub and Reina. Upload the App's unencrypted PEM private key below.
github-service-secrets-hint: Secrets are write-only. Leave a secret blank to keep its saved value for the same App. A different App requires new secrets. Client secret: paste the generated value from GitHub (1–4,096 characters); surrounding whitespace is removed. Webhook secret: 32–4,096 characters; whitespace is not changed.
github-private-key-description: The service operator uploads the App's PEM private key once for this service.
private-key-upload-hint: Select an unencrypted RSA private key downloaded from your GitHub App (at least 2048 bits). Maximum 32 KiB. Its contents are never displayed.
private-key-privacy-description: Reina returns only the key fingerprint and configuration status. Upload a new file to replace an existing key.
auth-api-key-method: Sign in with an API key
auth-api-key-method-hint: Use the provider's prompts, or configure a custom endpoint.
auth-methods-hint: Only methods supported by Reina are listed. Credentials save separately from model selection.
auth-supported-limits-description: OpenAI API keys use OpenAI. ChatGPT account login uses the separate OpenAI Codex provider. OpenAI and OpenRouter callback-based account login, Radius, filesystem credentials, and GitHub Enterprise login are not available here. A saved credential does not confirm subscription access or model availability.
copilot-policy-confirm-description: Starting GitHub Copilot sign-in may enable model policies on your GitHub account. Continue only if you permit these remote changes. Only public github.com accounts are supported.
auth-verification-link-hint: Open the verification link in a new tab. If your browser blocks it, copy the link address and open it yourself. Reina does not open popups automatically.
provider-api-hint: The API selects the wire protocol used for model requests.
provider-url-hint: Use an HTTPS API endpoint, including its version path. Do not include credentials, a query, or a fragment.
api-key-optional-hint: Write-only. You can add a key later; a key is required to use a model.
model-search-placeholder: Search by model name or ID
model-custom-entry-divider: Or enter a custom model below
model-id-hint: The exact model identifier. Start with a letter or digit; use only letters, digits, dots, underscores, slashes, and hyphens.
model-limits-hint: Context window: 4,096–4,000,000 tokens. Maximum output tokens setting: 256–4,096 tokens. Codex SDK 1.5.0 ignores this setting. Gateway time, request-count, and response-size limits still apply; they are not an upstream token or billing cap.
login-description: Sign in to configure your models and GitHub App connection.
login-security-hint: Secure access through your Pocket ID account.
login-error-failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
login-error-access-denied: This account does not have access to Reina. Contact your administrator.
login-error-not-configured: Sign-in is not configured. Contact your administrator.
error-request-invalid: The request could not be processed. Reload the page and try again.
error-input-invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
error-response-invalid: Reina returned an unexpected response. Reload the page and try again.
error-settings-unavailable: Settings are unavailable. Try again or contact your administrator.
error-provider-url-invalid: Use a public HTTPS endpoint without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error-provider-address-private: Use a public HTTPS provider endpoint. Private network addresses are not allowed.
error-provider-origin-changed: The provider redirected to a different origin. Check its base URL.
error-provider-endpoint-key-required: Enter a new API key when changing the provider endpoint.
error-provider-credential-required: Add a credential to this provider before selecting its model.
error-provider-reconnect-required: Update this provider's credential, then try again.
error-provider-credential-changed: This credential changed during setup. Close this dialog and try again.
error-model-unavailable: This model is not available for the saved credential. Choose another catalog model or reconnect.
error-model-limits: Use context and output settings within the selected catalog model's limits.
error-provider-response-required: Enter a response for the current provider prompt, then continue.
error-setup-expired: Sign-in expired. Go back and start again.
error-setup-cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. The previous credential is unchanged.
error-setup-failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Go back and try again.
error-setup-capacity: Too many sign-in attempts are active. Cancel an unused attempt or try later.
error-auth-method-unsupported: This sign-in method is not available for this provider.
error-session-inactive: Your Reina session is no longer active. Reload the page to sign in again.
error-copilot-consent-required: Confirm the GitHub Copilot policy changes before starting.
error-prompt-stale: This prompt is no longer active. Go back and start again.
error-authorization-url-unsafe: The provider returned an unsupported authorization link. Sign-in was stopped.
error-prompt-unsupported: This provider prompt is not supported in Reina.
error-provider-access-denied: Provider authorization was denied. Go back to try again.
error-provider-login-expired: Provider sign-in expired. Go back and start again.
error-provider-login-failed: Provider sign-in failed. Go back to try again.
error-model-duplicate: This model is already saved for this provider.
error-provider-limit: The limit of 50 providers has been reached. Delete an unused provider first.
error-model-limit: The limit of 500 models has been reached. Delete an unused model first.
error-file-read: The file could not be read. Select the PEM file again.
error-private-key-invalid: Select an unencrypted RSA private key in PEM format (at least 2048 bits).
error-github-not-configured: GitHub connection is not configured for this service. Ask the service operator to complete App setup.
error-github-expired: This GitHub connection attempt expired. Choose Connect GitHub to start again.
error-github-failed: GitHub connection could not be completed. Choose Connect GitHub to try again. Your saved repository is unchanged.
error-github-access-denied: GitHub authorization was denied. Your saved repository is unchanged. You can connect again when ready.
error-github-stale: This GitHub connection attempt is no longer current. Choose Connect GitHub to start again.
error-github-capacity: Too many GitHub connection attempts are active. Cancel an unused attempt or try again later.
error-github-url-unsafe: GitHub returned an unsupported navigation URL. Navigation was stopped. Start a new connection.
error-payload-too-large: The request is too large. Keep runtime settings within 512 KiB, PEM files within 32 KiB, and API keys within 8,192 characters.
error-item-not-found: This item no longer exists. Refresh settings and try again.
error-provider-not-found: This provider no longer exists. Refresh settings and try again.
error-model-not-found: This model no longer exists. Refresh settings and try again.
error-csrf-expired: Your security token has expired. Reload the page and try again.
error-action-forbidden: This action is not allowed. Reload the page and try again.
error-network: Could not reach Reina. Check your connection and try again.
error-action-failed: The action could not be completed. Check your settings and try again.
error-settings-load: Settings could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
error-settings-refresh-after-save: Changes were saved, but settings could not be refreshed. Retry loading settings before making more changes.
validation-value-invalid: Check this value and try again.
webhook-secret-replacement-hint: Secret configured. Leave blank to keep it, or enter at least 32 characters to replace it. Use the same secret in your GitHub App webhook configuration. The saved secret is never displayed.
runtime-reason-model-required: Choose a saved model to continue.
runtime-reason-github-setup: Ask the service operator to complete GitHub App setup.
runtime-reason-environment: Server environment settings are incomplete. Contact your administrator.
runtime-reason-cleanup: Server cleanup failed. Ask your administrator to check cleanup and restart Reina.
runtime-reason-settings-unavailable: Settings could not be read. Contact your administrator.
runtime-reason-authentication-sandbox: Check GitHub App credentials and server sandbox configuration.
runtime-identity-changed-warning: Repository or App identity changed. Stored Runtime settings were not changed. The worker image and forbidden paths were cleared in this form. Review the allowed paths, verification commands, and limits for this target before saving and applying.
runtime-connected-repository-description: Connected repository: {{repository}}. Identity is supplied by Connect GitHub. An exact match to the complete saved Runtime configuration can restart scans and use model quota. New or changed worker settings and policy require Runtime Save and apply. Coding still requires explicit approval.
runtime-no-repository-description: No connected repository. Connect GitHub to select a verified repository, or use Advanced GitHub identity to enter a manual target.
github-repository-metadata: {{repository}} · Repository ID {{repositoryId}} · Installation ID {{installationId}} · App ID {{appId}}
github-service-credential-status: Client secret: {{client}}. Webhook secret: {{webhook}}. Private key: {{key}}.
github-service-status-unavailable: Service App status is unavailable. Ask the service operator to update Reina before using Connect GitHub.
github-connect-idle-description: Choose Connect GitHub to authorize an account and select a repository. Your saved repository, if any, stays unchanged until you choose Use repository.
github-setup-missing-description: Missing service settings: {{fields}}. Choose Connect GitHub to open the required setup fields.
github-status-unavailable: GitHub service status is unavailable. Refresh settings or contact the service operator.
github-authorization-started: GitHub authorization has started. Complete authorization on GitHub, or cancel this attempt and connect again.
github-authorized-repositories-descripti: GitHub authorized{{user}}. Choose a repository, then choose Use repository to save it. Use Install / manage App to add repositories.
github-authorized-empty-description: GitHub authorized{{user}}, but no repositories are available. Install the App or request organization approval, then refresh repositories.
github-install-required-description: GitHub authorized{{user}}. No App installation with an available repository was found. Install the App or request organization approval, then refresh repositories.
provider-delete-warning: This deletes the saved connection, its credential, and all its saved models. If one is selected, the selection is cleared. Built-in providers remain in the catalog. This cannot be undone.
model-output-ignored: Maximum output tokens setting: ignored by SDK 1.5.0
model-selected-delete-warning: This deletes the saved model and clears the current selection. The provider and its credential will remain.
model-delete-warning: This deletes the saved model. The provider and its credential will remain.
model-provider-credential-required: Add a credential to {{name}} before selecting this model.
model-selected-notice: {{name}} selected. Check runtime status to confirm that the configuration is applied.
github-page-description: Connect your GitHub account and choose a repository.
runtime-page-description: Configure the repository, worker image, and runtime policy.
error-provider-catalog-unavailable: Catalog unavailable. Retry, or go back to choose another method. Custom endpoints are available only with API keys.
error-builtin-model-catalog-unavailable: Catalog unavailable. Close and reopen to retry. Built-in providers require a catalog model.
error-custom-model-catalog-unavailable: Catalog unavailable. Enter a custom model below, or close and reopen to retry.
provider-search-results: {{count}} providers. Select a provider to configure.
provider-search-empty: No matching providers. Try another search.
provider-method-empty: No providers support this method in Reina. Go back to choose another method.
provider-account-description: Providers available for sign in with an account. OpenAI Codex is separate from OpenAI API keys.
provider-api-key-description: Providers available for sign in with an API key. Built-in providers use their own setup prompts.
model-search-results: {{count}} models. Select a catalog model, then review it before saving.
model-builtin-search-empty: No matching catalog models. Try another search. Built-in providers require a catalog model.
model-custom-search-empty: No matching models. Try another search or enter a custom model below.
credential-management-description: {{status}} — {{method}}. Updating keeps this saved connection and authentication method. Models and selection save separately.
provider-api-key-replacement-hint: API key configured. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new key to replace it. Changing the endpoint requires a new key. The saved key is never returned.
provider-api-key-new-hint: Write-only. A key is needed to use a model. You can save the provider without one.
provider-sign-in-stopped: Sign-in stopped. Go back to try again.
provider-sign-in-error-notice: {{error}} Existing credentials and model selection were not changed by this attempt.
auth-account-authorize-instructions: Open this link to authorize your account.
error-authorization-link-unavailable: Authorization link unavailable: only secure HTTPS links are allowed. Go back and retry sign-in.
auth-device-code-instructions: Enter this code on the provider's verification page:
credential-saved-notice: Credential saved. Model selection is unchanged. Save a model, then use Select model to save your preference.
error-credential-refresh-after-save: Credential saved, but settings could not be refreshed. Retry loading settings before making more changes.
provider-prompt-required: Complete the provider prompt to continue.
provider-waiting: Waiting for the provider. You can go back or cancel sign-in.
model-builtin-id-hint: Built-in providers use exact catalog model IDs. Select a catalog model before saving. Each model keeps its own API and endpoint.
model-catalog-review-divider: Choose a catalog model, then review its name and limits below.
provider-supported-required: Choose a supported provider before continuing.
credential-remove-warning: This removes the credential from Reina and stops affected work. The saved connection and models remain, but a model selected from this provider is deselected. It does not revoke access at the provider or log you out of Pocket ID. To use this provider again, add a new credential. This cannot be undone.
provider-saved-notice: Provider saved. Save a model, then choose Select model to select it.
model-catalog-selection-required: Choose a catalog model with Select catalog model before saving.
model-saved-notice: Model saved. Use Select model to save your model preference.
validation-path-patterns: Enter 1–64 unique repository-relative patterns, one per line, with up to 256 characters each.
validation-command-arrays: Enter a JSON array of 1–8 argv arrays, such as [["npm","run","ci"]]. Each command needs 1–32 non-empty string arguments, up to 4,096 characters each, without line breaks or null characters.
validation-positive-id: Enter a whole number from 1 to 9,007,199,254,740,991.
validation-webhook-secret: Use at least 32 characters without leading or trailing spaces or control characters.
runtime-settings-saved-notice: Runtime settings saved and reload requested. Refresh status to check the applied state.
github-setup-incomplete-notice: Complete the one-time service setup. Missing: {{fields}}.
github-service-refresh-required: Service App status is unavailable. Refresh settings before continuing.
github-authorization-opening: Opening official GitHub authorization in this tab…
github-install-opening: Opening the official GitHub App installation page in this tab…
github-connection-cancelled: GitHub connection attempt cancelled. Your saved repository and Runtime settings are unchanged.
github-repository-connected-notice: Repository connected. An exact match to the complete saved Runtime configuration can restart scans and use model quota. New or changed worker settings and policy require Runtime Save and apply. Coding still requires explicit approval.
validation-client-secret: Paste only the client secret value from GitHub (1–4,096 characters, without embedded control characters).
validation-secret-length: Use {{minimum}}–4,096 characters without leading or trailing spaces or control characters.
github-service-app-saved-notice: Service App settings saved. Complete any missing service credentials, then use Connect GitHub. Runtime configuration and coding approval remain separate.
validation-pem-file: Select a non-empty PEM file no larger than 32 KiB.
github-private-key-saved: GitHub App private key saved. Configuration will be applied automatically.
github-private-key-delete-warning: Reina will no longer have a GitHub App private key. Upload a new key to restore the connection. This cannot be undone.
runtime-reload-requested: Configuration reload requested. Refresh settings to check the applied state.
session-signed-out: Signed out of the Reina session. Provider credentials and Pocket ID sign-in are unchanged.
model-catalog-choice-required: Choose a model from the catalog first.
model-codex-catalog-selected-notice: Catalog model selected for this form. Codex SDK 1.5.0 ignores the maximum output tokens setting. Gateway time, request-count, and response-size limits still apply; they are not an upstream token or billing cap. Save the model, then select it separately for Reina.
model-catalog-selected-notice: Catalog model selected for this form. Review its settings, then save. The maximum output tokens setting is at most 4,096. Select the saved model separately for Reina.
